hypothesised_pattern: High targets (about 0.7-0.87) occur when x2 and x5 share a sign and |x4| is large, while low targets (about 0.14-0.23) occur when x2 and x5 have opposite signs and x4 is near zero, a combined interaction-plus-quadratic effect the base model flattens.
functional_form_guess: bounded additive: sigmoid(a*x2*x5 + b*x4**2 + const), approximated as a*x2*x5 + b*(x4**2 - 1)
rationale: All seven high-target rows have x2*x5 > 0 (about 0.9 to 3.2) and |x4| of at least 1.26, while the three low-target rows have x2*x5 < 0 (about -1.0 to -1.2) and |x4| of at most 0.15. The base model predicts roughly 0.4-0.55 for all of them, so it is missing both the sign-agreement interaction and the even x4 effect. The targets stay inside (0, 1), which suggests a saturating link.
